summary: Iteration 7 verified: Android permissions (INTERNET/ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE) in app.json, Android TV config plugin ./plugins/withAndroidTv, expo-screen-orientation rotation + NEW player-fullscreen-btn, orientation 'default', and non-blocking background source refresh with 12h default window. BACKEND: full pytest suite 18/18 PASSED in 22.35s (test_iptv_api.py) — /api/guide?hours=12 exactly 12h window, 688 channels, >100 with programs; /api/status/source 688 channels & 665 with EPG; /api/refresh advances last_refresh; auth login case-sensitive success + 4 negatives; verify valid/missing/invalid; POST /api/settings requires Bearer and mirrors status — m3u4u defaults RESTORED via TestProtectedSettings::test_settings_post_updates_and_status_reflects (m3u_url=http://m3u4u.com/m3u/jwmzn1grpmu99585n721, epg_url=http://m3u4u.com/xml/jwmzn1grpmu99585n721). FRONTEND (390x844 web preview): guide painted from cache with no infinite spin — 34 epg-channel-* rows out of 688 (virtualization holds), 490 epg-prog-* cells, sticky left logo column, time header, red now-line visible in screenshot, and duration-sized LIVE program blocks render. Tapping first epg-channel- (AETV.us m3u4u) navigates to /player?channelId=AETV.us%20%28m3u4u%29. Player overlay confirms player-back-btn=true, NEW player-fullscreen-btn=true, and surf rail 54 items (surf-*). Tapping player-fullscreen-btn did NOT crash the app (fs button still present, no red screen, no console error). Toggled back — still stable. 'Unable to play this stream — Live playback needs the installed app build — not the Expo Go preview' overlay appears as EXPECTED (libVLC native-only, NOT a failure). player-back-btn returns to /. REGRESSION: mode-box-btn renders 76 box-channel-* tiles; mode-timeline-btn restores; 7 date-* chips visible (Today .. Tue 21); group chips All/Favorites/Local/Movies render. Search tab: typing 'espn' returns ESPN entries in the results text. Favorites tab reachable. Settings tab shows Channels loaded 688 / with EPG 665 / Last refreshed, settings-refresh-btn present, 'Refresh Playlist Now' + Admin Login CTA visible. Admin login not exercised on frontend this iteration — creds are exercised in backend suite (login success + POST /api/settings with m3u4u defaults restored). Deprecated packages detected: none new. React Native issues detected: only the carryover props.pointerEvents web deprecation warning (non-blocking, from iterations 1-6). Overall no regressions from iter-6 virtualization gains; new fullscreen button works safely in web preview; device-level fullscreen/rotation and native TV/Leanback can only be fully verified on a real EAS build.

react_native_issues.issue: Non-blocking RN web deprecation warning still logged on app load: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Carryover from iterations 1-6. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:192 (inline style.pointerEvents on nowLine).

action_items: OPTIONAL (unchanged from iter 4-6): migrate the last props.pointerEvents usage to style.pointerEvents in /app/frontend/src/components/TimelineGrid.tsx:192 to silence RN web deprecation warning.

Device-only verifications that CANNOT be exercised in web preview and require a fresh EAS Android build install: (a) INTERNET/ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE effectively grant network on real device install, (b) LEANBACK_LAUNCHER category + leanback/touchscreen uses-feature make the app appear in Android TV launcher, (c) tapping player-fullscreen-btn calls ScreenOrientation.lockAsync(LANDSCAPE) then back to PORTRAIT_UP+unlockAsync on device.
critical_code_review_comments: app.json orientation is 'default' (line 6) — allows OS-driven rotation while store/player can override with expo-screen-orientation. Permissions array (lines 22-26) includes INTERNET, ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE, POST_NOTIFICATIONS. Plugins list adds expo-screen-orientation and ./plugins/withAndroidTv (lines 61-62) alongside existing react-native-vlc-media-player.

plugins/withAndroidTv.js correctly uses @expo/config-plugins withAndroidManifest + AndroidConfig.Manifest.getMainApplicationOrThrow. Both uses-feature entries (touchscreen, leanback) set android:required='false' so the same APK still installs on phones. LEANBACK_LAUNCHER is appended only when LAUNCHER category is present and not already there — idempotent.

player.tsx: useEffect at lines 39-45 calls ScreenOrientation.unlockAsync() on mount and again on unmount (web guarded). toggleFullscreen (47-64) is web-safe (early return with local state toggle) and native uses lockAsync LANDSCAPE / PORTRAIT_UP + unlockAsync — try/catch swallows errors safely. player-fullscreen-btn (line 154) is placed in the top scrim with 40x40 hit-area (styles.fsBtn) — meets 44px target when combined with padding; consider bumping to 44x44 exact for strict a11y.

store.tsx (117-134): first refresh() is awaited (fast paint from cached backend), then api.refresh().then(refresh(true)).catch(()=>{}) fires in the background — non-blocking as claimed; store never sets loading=true for that background call because refresh(silent=true) skips setLoading, so no spinner regression on subsequent guide arrival.
api.ts still uses AbortController + 25000/45000 timeouts. Guide default in store.tsx line 88 is 12h (matches backend TestGuide::test_guide_12h_default_window).
